description: Returns the current user's favorite timesheets, the saved rows the Kimai UI offers as one-click restart targets. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. Requires the 'start_own_timesheet' permission in addition to API access. HAND-AUTHORED: this endpoint postdates the vendored spec, so its shape was taken from src/API/FavoritesController.php upstream rather than extracted. It takes no parameters and is not paginated.

200.description: Returns the collection of favorite timesheets for the current user

404.description: Kimai older than 2.66.0: the favorites routes do not exist

summary: Add a timesheet to the favorites
description: Marks one timesheet as a favorite for the current user. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. The caller must OWN the timesheet ('is_owner'), so this cannot favorite another user's row even with admin rights. Idempotent in effect: favoriting an already-favorited timesheet is not an error. HAND-AUTHORED from src/API/FavoritesController.php; takes no request body, the id in the path is the whole input.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Timesheet ID to add to the favorites

403.description: Not the owner of this timesheet, or missing start_own_timesheet

404.description: Timesheet not found, or Kimai older than 2.66.0

summary: Remove a timesheet from the favorites
description: Removes the favorite MARKER from one timesheet. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. THIS DOES NOT DELETE THE TIMESHEET -- the time record is untouched and only the current user's favorite flag is cleared, which is trivially undone by calling post_favorite_timesheet again. It is nonetheless classified destructive and sits behind KIMAI_ALLOW_DELETE, because the catalog classifies every DELETE that way by method; that is a deliberately blunt rule and this endpoint is the one place it currently overreaches. The caller must own the timesheet. HAND-AUTHORED from src/API/FavoritesController.php.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Timesheet ID to remove from the favorites

403.description: Not the owner of this timesheet, or missing start_own_timesheet

404.description: Timesheet not found, or Kimai older than 2.66.0

description: Deletes an invoice AND its generated document, and releases the timesheets it covered back to un-invoiced. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. This is genuinely irreversible: the rendered document is removed from disk and the invoice number is consumed, so re-invoicing the same period produces a NEW number rather than restoring the old one. Requires the 'delete_invoice' permission. HAND-AUTHORED from src/API/InvoiceController.php.

204.description: Invoice and its document were deleted

404.description: Invoice not found, or Kimai older than 2.66.0

description: Deletes an invoice DOCUMENT TEMPLATE FILE (a .docx/.ods/.twig renderer in the invoice document directory), not an invoice. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. Requires 'manage_invoice_template'. NOTE the id here is a STRING document name, not a numeric id -- this is the one invoice route without a \d+ requirement upstream. HAND-AUTHORED from src/API/InvoiceController.php; verify the identifier against the Kimai UI before calling, since a wrong value cannot be distinguished from a missing one in the 404.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Invoice document identifier (a name, NOT a numeric id)

404.description: Document not found, or Kimai older than 2.66.0

description: Deletes an invoice TEMPLATE (the configured template entity that binds a document, a number generator and tax settings), not an invoice and not a document file. Added in Kimai 2.66.0. Requires 'manage_invoice_template'. Deleting a template in use affects future invoice generation for anything pointing at it. HAND-AUTHORED from src/API/InvoiceController.php.

404.description: Template not found, or Kimai older than 2.66.0
